entries.idea_and_source_location: Mean kernel: Eqs. (1), (3)–(9), VI-C; geometry: Fig. 2. See bibliography attributions.
entries.recorded_result: Four selected-variant records completed; saved comparisons to legacy have identical state-stream hashes and zero saved-position differences. This tests implementation equivalence only.
entries.failures_and_unresolved_applicability: No recorded experiment compares velocities, force, moments or trajectories against physical measurements; the 27 g extrapolation remains unvalidated.

entries.causality_note: This audit occurred after the recorded exact-code campaign. It does not claim these papers guided its design or constitute physical reference data.
actual_repository_use_evidence: outputs/milestone-28-source/study.cjs:16 calls the response an assumed constant ideal induced-power relation
src/exact-aero.cjs:116–121 delegates to effectiveThrust and retains nominal yaw torque
entries.idea_and_source_location: Bauersfeld VII-A Eqs. (10)–(11) concern maintained-thrust power. Jain II-C Eqs. (5)–(8) are a distinct empirical response. Neither is evidence that the exact cubic is a validated motor/rotor law.
entries.recorded_result: Same receiver conversion runs under legacy and lean; equality between these implementations does not test the conversion against an independent force reference.
entries.audit_algebra: Writing T=f0*x, alpha=U/sqrt(f0/(2*rho*A)) and imposing idealPower(T,U)=idealPower(f0,0) gives x*(alpha/2+sqrt(alpha^2/4+x))=1, hence x^3+alpha*x-1=0. This audit derivation confirms internal algebra, not motor physics.
entries.failures_and_unresolved_applicability: Rotor electrical power, RPM, inflow response, airframe loads and yaw disturbance are not independently calibrated.
entries.next_test_hypothesis: A measured force/moment grid at documented voltage/RPM can discriminate this fixed-power surrogate from a fitted receiver model. Not run.

entries.idea_and_source_location: The code adds 2–2.5 m downstream fade/cutoff, 2–3 half-width radial fade/cutoff, 3 m neighbor radius, 20-degree tilt guard, 0.15 m near-wake cylinder and axial scalar superposition. These values are not attributed to verified experimental support by the cited paper.
entries.recorded_result: Code-equivalence checks preserve the existing positive contributions within this finite-support law. Their omission-free claim is conditional on the already-truncated model.
entries.failures_and_unresolved_applicability: No external overlapping-wake, far-tail, tilted-flight, moving-wake or wall/ground-effect validation in this campaign.
entries.next_test_hypothesis: Independent multiple-source data can distinguish sum, RSS and interacting-wake responses without reusing simulation output as ground truth. Not run.

entries.historical_provenance: unverified provenance; structural correspondence is retrospective, not proof the paper was consulted during implementation
entries.source_idea: Local collision avoidance, velocity matching and local centering define the behavioral model. A shared migratory target can coexist with local flock decisions; the paper also discusses spatial bins.
entries.source_assumptions_and_limits: Behavioral animation with simplified geometric flight and local perception, not a quadrotor dynamics or collision-safety theorem. The original prioritization and distance weighting differ from this implementation.
entries.used_in_this_audit: Classify the controller and bound the term genuine local 3D Boids. No Reynolds coefficients or physics equations are transplanted.

entries.our_observation: The three social terms operate on all three position/velocity components, with strict 1.8 m local radius and shared route. Fourteen short records and eight matched comparisons establish deterministic replay consistency, not a full obstacle mission.
applicability_gaps: No evidence the original paper supplied current weights, route or wall-priority filter.
No long-horizon convergence, delayed sensing or safety proof follows from Boids terminology.

entries.source_idea: Separate grid-based candidate generation from exact primitive testing. Cell size trades bucket occupancy against traversal; timestamped buckets avoid clearing untouched table entries.

entries.source_assumptions_and_limits: Tetrahedral vertex-in-volume detection, not wake evaluation; edge-only intersection is omitted. Linear scaling needs bounded local occupancy. Its average-edge-length optimum and timing hardware do not transfer to drone fields.
entries.used_in_this_audit: Interpret current exact search overhead and motivate H2 only. No claim that the published collision detector proves the wake support envelope.

entries.our_observation: Current grid uses full integer-triple string keys, sorted source IDs and an exact strict-radius predicate. Support/reuse add geometric exact-zero tests; they did not consistently outperform lean. Reuse refreshes geometry and owns each returned wind array.
applicability_gaps: No collision-detector runtime or asymptotic guarantee establishes current grid performance.
Dense packing can increase pair count quadratically even with a grid.
Existing numeric coordinate guard and support proof must survive any future indexing rewrite.

entries.historical_provenance: unverified provenance; not a reproduction of the published statistical procedure
entries.source_idea: Quantify effect sizes and uncertainty; identify variation at iteration, execution and compilation levels; establish warmup/independence on the tested system.
entries.source_assumptions_and_limits: The paper estimates mean-time ratios with multilevel variance/Fieller machinery and assumptions on independent observations. Its DaCapo/SPEC repetition counts are platform-specific, not universal prescriptions.
entries.used_in_this_audit: Bound inference from saved campaign timing and motivate H1. The campaign’s median paired-ratio percentile bootstrap is a different estimator.

entries.our_observation: Complete-output checks, matched work, rotated method order and separate controls are useful. Existing intervals describe small within-process samples on this machine; independent pipeline gain versus previous-zero is 4.0% with interval crossing no change.
applicability_gaps: No saved dimensioning study establishes post-warmup independence or cross-process variance.
Five thousand bootstrap resamples are not five thousand independent executions.
Primary/independent checksum timing differs, so those measurements cannot be pooled.
Exact matching of outputs is required separately; performance statistics cannot validate physical fidelity.

entries.historical_provenance: unverified provenance; no adaptive expansion arithmetic is implemented in the campaign
entries.source_idea: Geometric branch decisions can fail under roundoff. Certify a cheap decision using error analysis, otherwise refine it; mathematically equivalent coordinate expressions can have different error behavior.
entries.source_assumptions_and_limits: Radix-two correctly rounded arithmetic; overflow/underflow are outside the short paper’s scope. Its determinant error bounds do not bound this code’s quaternion transforms, Math.hypot or nonlinear wake kernel.
entries.used_in_this_audit: Interpret the retained false cull and separate floating-point program equivalence from exact real arithmetic. Uncertain culling should conservatively fall through to the unchanged kernel.

entries.our_observation: A v0 huge-translation case lost a positive 0.001587065203100887 m/s contribution in support/reuse. A2 bounds each position component to ±1e6 m and inflates the envelope. Lean preserves kernel ordering and does not use the support branch.
applicability_gaps: Passing sampled regressions is not a formal floating-point soundness proof over every accepted state.
Changing to high-precision wake values would change the target semantics; exact-to-legacy and exact-over-reals are different goals.
This source does not retrospectively prove the chosen 128*EPSILON*1e6 margin.
